orb.description: A glassy sphere with a fresnel rim and a soft halo. The simplest object and the reference for the others.

ring.description: A glassy torus, tilted toward the viewer. Spin it, or put it in orbit around something.

crystal.description: A faceted octahedral gem. Hard edges, flat facets, sharp highlights.

coil.description: A helix of glassy tube, like a spring seen from the side.

blob.description: A soft sphere that wobbles like liquid. The most organic object in the set.

cube.description: A rounded glass cube. Calm and architectural, a good center of gravity.

knot.description: A glassy torus knot: one tube that winds around a ring and through itself.

prism.description: A glass prism with flat faces and crisp edges, from a triangle to an octagon.

capsule.description: A rounded glass pill lying on a diagonal. Soft and friendly, it reads well small.

star.description: A glass star with beveled edges, like a cut ornament.

shell.description: A spiral shell: glass beads that grow along a logarithmic spiral, like a nautilus.

disc.description: A glass coin with a beveled edge and a gently domed face, turned to catch the light.
